observations: 62 authored diagrams are pinned by no block at all. They reach a student only through the packet-2 title fallback, which is a heuristic, so more than half the diagram library is placed by guesswork.

Three of the fifteen missing diagrams already exist in a sibling section. Diagrams are stored per section in section_diagrams, so there is no way to reference one from another. A shared diagram library would remove three of the fifteen and prevent the next duplicate.
